svg.font-family: Noto Sans, DejaVu Sans, Liberation Sans, Arial, sans-serif
svg.title: 01-architecture-layers
svg.text: Layered Cargo workspace; a crate may depend only on lower layers (checked by cargo xtask layers)
Single binary: GUI by default, CLI subcommands, mcp, --self-test. Wires
egui/eframe shell: tabs, sidebar, dialogs, terminal /
Control client, CLI, MCP server; no egui.
Session manager, command registry, transfer queue, authorization /
approval / audit boundary, control server; owns tokio.
XDG dirs; Secret Service via oo7; XDG
Domain types: Session, Folder, Protocol, Tunnel, theme tokens,
Command/Event, FileOps trait, errors; no IO.
OS contracts: paths, keyring, theme source, clipboard,
Arrows show key paths; the ledger includes lower-layer links omitted from the drawing.
rxt-engine → rxt-store, rxt-term, rxt-ssh, rxt-sftp, rxt-ftp, rxt-rdp,
rxt-ui → rxt-engine, rxt-store, rxt-term, rxt-platform, rxt-core
Every crate also depends on rxt-core. Same-layer exceptions: rxt-platform → rxt-core, rxt-sftp → rxt-ssh; also rxt-vnc → rxt-ssh for VNC over SSH.
Protocol and store crates never depend on a concrete platform adapter; UI crates (egui) are forbidden below L4.
